verdict.rationale: No documentation or evidence addresses data retention, deletion policies, or user control over AI/data lifecycle; the evidence pack covers API access, OAuth, and MCP plugin setup but nothing on retention/deletion controls. Community evidence even raises concerns about broad internal data access/misuse, but that doesn't speak to deletion controls specifically. missing for 10: any documentation of data retention policy, deletion mechanisms/APIs, or user-facing controls for purging AI-processed data.
